title: Aloo Khaoge
description: A fun fan-made Minecraft resource pack based on the viral Indian “Aloo Khaoge?” trend.
body:
![aloo khaoge?](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7214be7cc9f479052edecc72755d15e9b01d37f6.png)
This is a fan-made Minecraft resource pack inspired by the viral Indian “Aloo Khaoge?” trend.

This pack is made only for fun and for the Indian Minecraft and meme community.
![items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/72a63936a31567109494377866e93359da643f80_0.webp)
Features:
- Zombie texture edited
- Cooked potato texture edited
- Totem pop sound replaced with the famous “Aloo Khaoge?” in voice gaming voice
- Golden apple edited

This is NOT an official pack made for voice gaming .
It is only a fan-made project created for entertainment.
